admission_contract: One provider and one fixed task class at a time; no cross-provider fallback.
Read the provider's current official CLI and permission documentation before implementation.
Prove authentication/entitlement without exposing credentials or account data.
Record a declared cost ceiling and fail-closed rate-limit behavior.
Build a provider-specific persisted-session adapter and restricted disposable canary.
Independently review the adapter, canary, stop behavior, provenance, and terminal fence handling.
Use a named activation packet and one bounded no-op before any broader task class.
Keep the broker shadow-only and do not enable scheduler, warm pool, or fallback without a separate review.
